decision.explanation: Each of these population figures corresponds to a distinct Licking Township and a specific point in time based on the original sources. '7,899' refers to Licking Township, Blackford County, Indiana, as of the 2010 census (D1S2). '7,723' refers to the same township as of 1 April 2020 (D3S1). '3,870' refers to Licking Township, Licking County, Ohio, as of the 2000 census (D5S2). '536' refers to Licking Township, Clarion County, Pennsylvania, as of the 2010 census (D6S7). These are distinct referents and valid answers.
